title: Sunday · the Rain, 2008
logline: Eleventh January. The garage window, the alley, the tavern's beer sign in a puddle. Three tiers, one place.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the gravel alley behind the tavern in rain from the garage porch. The beer sign's neon in a puddle. Nobody.

image.prompt: a gravel alley behind a tavern in January rain seen from a garage porch, a beer sign's neon reflected in a puddle, nobody, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Alley

panels.composition: Tier 2: the casement window from outside, the lamp inside, two jars on the sill, a shape at the table.

image.prompt: a small casement window seen from a rainy alley with a lamp lit inside, two jars on the sill, the shape of a man at a table, watercolor

panels.name: Window

panels.composition: Tier 3: the alley, later. The lamp off. The puddle dark. Held.

image.prompt: the same alley later with the window dark and the puddle black, rain, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Dark
